Axiom:
After all reopens are prepared, dispatch the reopened tasks through execute as one BATCH. The batch orchestrator will plan layers, run phases, close rounds, sync trackers.
Audit flag: pass `skip-audit` to the batch — the group-audit gate (`AX_AUDIT_HOOK`) is skipped for every ticket in the batch; the reconcile-level safety net (verify + one fresh-eyes audit + code-review over the whole reconciled set) runs ONCE at STEP_7 instead. (The batch still runs phases but skips the per-ticket `sdd-task --audit-group` dispatch.)
